title: NextDC Soars 43% on Goodman, Digital Realty Data Center Stake
summary: Gotrade News - NextDC shares jumped nearly 43% to A$9.34 on Thursday (Nov 5) after Goodman Group and Digital Realty (DLR) , through a trust they control
body_markdown:
According to NextDC's[investor center](https://www.nextdc.com/investor-centre) , the company booked FY26 net revenue of A$405.0 million and EBITDA of A$248.8 million. The same page lists FY26 contracted utilization of 740.1 MW against billing utilization of 175 MW.


## Digital Realty (DLR): Co-Owner of the Buying Trust


Digital Realty, listed on the New York Stock Exchange, holds the trust that ran the bookbuild in equal shares with Goodman, according to Investing.com. Both buyers told investors they have no current intention of making a takeover bid for NextDC but reserved the right to do so, as reported by CNBC.


## CoreWeave (CRWV) and Iren (IREN): Data Center Stocks Fell on Midterm Scrutiny


In the US,[CoreWeave (CRWV)](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/crwv/) and[Iren (IREN)](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/iren/) fell on Wednesday as[data center stocks sold off](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/ai-and-data-center-stocks-slide-on-texas-governor-upset/) after Democratic midterm victories raised expectations of tighter scrutiny and possible restrictions on data center development, according to CNBC.
